raw_answer_text:
Since the router points `block` figures at `reference/scene.md` and `reference/layout.md`, which I don't have loaded, I've stuck to only the genre-independent syntax explicitly documented in the core spec (block openers take a quoted label; edges connect declared ids) and avoided any layout/pin tuning or experimental extensions.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal job"
block caclient "CA client"
block ca "Certificate authority"
block deployagent "Deploy agent"
block service "Service"

scheduler -> renewaljob
renewaljob -> caclient
caclient -> ca
renewaljob -> deployagent
deployagent -> service
```

Before treating this as final, run it through `build-svg.js` — I have not loaded `reference/scene.md` or `reference/layout.md`, so the exact block/edge spellings above are my best inference from the core spec's rules ("every block opener" has a quoted label, ids are bare tokens) rather than confirmed genre syntax. If the build reports a line error, the message will name the correct spelling to use instead.
